review_candidates.description: ABOUT SPARK MICROGRANTS Spark MicroGrants believes in a world where everyone lives with dignity and determines their own positive future. Spark has worked in 1000+ villages in 6 countries and has pioneered a community-driven development model in sub-Saharan Africa. Our model combines facilitated community meetings with a small, discretionary grant to catalyze local action and institution building. Read more about our Approach, Impact and Values on our website. They will have deep experience in financial analysis, reporting, systems and tools, and are equally comfortable estimating high level information and building detailed models to support financial analysis and decision making. This role is an individual contributor and is a hands-on producer of value-added financial analysis, modeling, and reporting, and will report directly to the CFO. The incumbent will collaborate with senior leadership, and work extensively with the fundraising team on donor and Board deliverables and on helping the organization and its stakeholders understand the financial impacts of new projects and partnerships. They will also lead enterprise functions including risk management and cash forecasting, and lead key aspects of financial operations on behalf of the CFO. They will implement effective tracking and monitoring of Global and US operations OKRs, metrics and customer deliverables, and ensure appropriate follow-up and communication with stakeholders. Due to the amount of coordination with the fundraising team they will need to be based in the US and available on US East Coast time schedules, as well as being available to meet with teammates in Africa during cross-over time zones. Own financial processes for donor budgets, including templates, guidelines, metrics and analysis. Collaborate with program and functional teams to provide value added analysis and model future scenarios. Lead financial due diligence responses, and ensure adequate policies and practices are in place to satisfy key donor expectations and deliverables. Annual Budget, forecasting, and actual versus budget analysis Forecast quarterly, annual and long term revenue and cash flows, and model alternative scenarios, in support of budgeting and strategic planning processes. Ensure effective and timely tracking of forecasted revenues, cash flows and donor restrictions. Provide financial guidance to global support functions, including Operations, Fundraising, Executive and Innovation teams, and execute the annual budget process together with these teams. They will also provide reporting and analysis in support of the monthly Budget vs Actual (BVA) process and quarterly forecasting updates. Financial support to the Innovation team on proposals, pilot projects and research Work with the Chief Innovation Officer to model new opportunities, and to provide budgeting, reporting and analysis of pilot projects. Support the implementation of new processes and systems required to accommodate new workstreams, and coordinate the hand-over of expanding programs to the core finance team. Provide financial support for Social Return on Investment calculations and other financial metrics that aid decision making on where to allocate resources. Build organization-wide financial reporting and optimize finance tools Work closely with the Head of Finance and CFO to design and build financial reporting models to meet internal and external needs, Ensure optimal use of the current Netsuite reporting tools to ensure that reporting meets customer needs. Use AI effectively and responsibly to help the finance team become more efficient. Create effective materials to report financial status and forecasts to the internal Executive Committee, as well as to the Board, and Board Finance Committee. Implement financial processes, reporting, templates and budgets in support of new grants and projects, before handing off to the Country Finance team. Risk Management Implement enterprise risk tracking and action registers. Coordinate enterprise insurance policies and other risk mitigations. Work with Country Finance Managers and the Head of Finance to ensure appropriate funds available in each region. Lead the development of key global policies and procedures including those related to risk management, treasury, and legal. US & Global Operations Lead the implementation and effective use of operations dashboards, metrics, and global procedures. Coordinate US Operations including financial operations, procurement, and compliance with state and federal regulations. Lead strategic Finance and Operations projects and cross-functional initiatives. Experience designing and creating value-added reporting for internal and external stakeholders. Experience with non-profit programs, grants finance, and donor budgets is highly desirable. Netsuite, Google workspace, Business intelligence tools, and strong Excel/google sheets skills. Strong Communicator: You can translate financial concepts for non-financial audiences and provide clear explanations of information and analysis to audiences of varying levels. Strategic thinking with the ability to support organizational growth and change Solutions-oriented and proactive Detail oriented but also able to create high level summarized analysis Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multi-country environment.
